sourceData.description: No lone creature stands long against many hunting as one. When the pack closes on prey cut off from help, they fall on it together and drag it down by sheer combined weight, pulling it to the ground before it can break free.

magicEffects.Description: Pulled to the ground by many at once.

props.Description: Stillness erupting into violence. The Beast lies unseen in the undergrowth until the moment to strike, then bursts from cover at full speed, the sudden charge giving its prey no time to ready before it is upon them.
props.TriggerText: When the Beast bursts from cover.

props.RequirementText: Quadruped body; moved at least 2 squares before the attack.
props.Description: A leaping natural-weapon attack that uses movement to bowl the prey down under sudden force. It is declared before an attack is resolved. In play, it adds 1 multiplier die, and applies the prone condition. It requires a weapon with natural; Quadruped body; moved at least 2 squares before the attack.
